tools.name: qvoo_get_workspace
tools.description: Get the workspace name, timezone, currency and active modules. Good first call to confirm the connection. Qvoo API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}.

tools.name: qvoo_get_schema
tools.description: List the standard and custom field definitions for leads, contacts and customers. Use it before you create records with custom fields. Qvoo API: GET /schema.

tools.name: qvoo_list_leads
tools.description: List leads in the workspace, one page at a time. Qvoo API: GET /leads.

tools.name: qvoo_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead with its status, stage, tags and custom fields. Qvoo API: GET /leads/{leadId}.

tools.name: qvoo_list_recent_leads
tools.description: List leads created in the last N hours (default set by Qvoo). Qvoo API: GET /leads/recent.

tools.name: qvoo_sync_leads
tools.description: Incremental lead sync: leads changed since a timestamp, with a cursor for the next page. Qvoo API: GET /leads/sync.

tools.name: qvoo_get_lead_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one lead. Qvoo API: GET /leads/{leadId}/comments.

tools.name: qvoo_check_duplicate_lead
tools.description: Check whether a lead with this phone number already exists. It only reads and creates nothing. Qvoo API: POST /leads/check-duplicate.

tools.name: qvoo_list_properties
tools.description: List properties in the workspace, one page at a time. Qvoo API: GET /properties.

tools.name: qvoo_get_property
tools.description: Get one property with its price, type, location and status. Qvoo API: GET /properties/{propertyId}.

tools.name: qvoo_list_property_units
tools.description: List the units of one property. Qvoo API: GET /properties/{propertyId}/units.

tools.name: qvoo_list_property_towers
tools.description: List the towers or blocks of one property. Qvoo API: GET /properties/{propertyId}/towers.

tools.name: qvoo_get_property_inventory
tools.description: Get the property inventory summary for the workspace. Qvoo API: GET /properties/inventory.

tools.name: qvoo_get_property_availability
tools.description: Get the availability list for properties in the workspace. Qvoo API: GET /properties/availability.

tools.name: qvoo_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the workspace, one page at a time. Qvoo API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: qvoo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact with its name, phone, email and custom fields. Qvoo API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: qvoo_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (won deals) in the workspace, one page at a time. Qvoo API: GET /customers.

tools.name: qvoo_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer with its deal date, amounts and linked property. Qvoo API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: qvoo_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the workspace, one page at a time. Qvoo API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: qvoo_get_task
tools.description: Get one task with its title, due date, status, priority and assignee. Qvoo API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: qvoo_get_team_members
tools.description: List the team members of the workspace. Their ids are the assignee values for tasks. Qvoo API: GET /team.

tools.name: qvoo_get_metadata
tools.description: List the workspace's lead statuses, lead stages, lead sources, lead tags or property types. Qvoo API: GET /metadata/{kind}.

tools.name: qvoo_list_whatsapp_conversations
tools.description: List WhatsApp conversations, with optional search and status filters. Qvoo API: GET /whatsapp/conversations.

tools.name: qvoo_list_whatsapp_templates
tools.description: List the WhatsApp message templates approved for the workspace. Qvoo API: GET /whatsapp/templates.

tools.name: qvoo_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead. Name and mobile number are required by Qvoo. Creates a new record in the CRM. Qvoo API: POST /leads.

tools.name: qvoo_update_lead
tools.description: Replace a lead's details. Qvoo takes the full lead body, so send name and mobile_number with every change. Qvoo API: PUT /leads/{leadId}.

tools.name: qvoo_add_lead_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a lead. It is visible to the team in Qvoo. Qvoo API: POST /leads/{leadId}/comments.

tools.name: qvoo_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Name and mobile number are required by Qvoo. Qvoo API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: qvoo_update_contact
tools.description: Replace a contact's details. Qvoo takes the full contact body, so send name and mobile_number with every change. Qvoo API: PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: qvoo_create_task
tools.description: Create a task. Title and assignee are required by Qvoo; the assignee is a team member id (see qvoo_get_team_members). Qvoo API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: qvoo_update_task
tools.description: Replace a task's details. Qvoo takes the full task body, so send title and assigned_to with every change. Qvoo API: PUT /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: qvoo_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete. Completing a task that is already complete changes nothing. Qvoo API: POST /tasks/{id}/complete.

tools.name: qvoo_reopen_task
tools.description: Mark a completed task as open again. Qvoo API: POST /tasks/{id}/reopen.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qvoo_get_lead_comments, qvoo_check_duplicate_lead, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_list_whatsapp_templates, qvoo_reopen_task · Private data: qvoo_get_schema, qvoo_list_contacts, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_create_lead, qvoo_create_contact, qvoo_update_contact · Public sink: qvoo_check_duplicate_lead, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_create_lead, qvoo_update_lead, qvoo_add_lead_comment, qvoo_create_contact, qvoo_update_contact, qvoo_create_task, qvoo_update_task, qvoo_complete_task, qvoo_reopen_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qvoo_get_lead_comments, qvoo_check_duplicate_lead, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_list_whatsapp_templates, qvoo_reopen_task · Private data: qvoo_get_schema, qvoo_list_contacts, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_create_lead, qvoo_create_contact, qvoo_update_contact · Public sink: qvoo_check_duplicate_lead, qvoo_get_contact, qvoo_create_lead, qvoo_update_lead, qvoo_add_lead_comment, qvoo_create_contact, qvoo_update_contact, qvoo_create_task, qvoo_update_task, qvoo_complete_task, qvoo_reopen_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
